results.title: Igor - L'eroe romantico del calcio
results.overview: A portrait of Igor Protti, the Rimini-born striker who was top scorer four times across Serie A, B and C and played for Bari, Lazio, Messina, Napoli and Livorno. It covers his career, his 1999 decision to turn down a bigger contract and stay with Livorno, and his life off the pitch. Former players and coaches including Walter Mazzarri, Giuseppe Signori, Cristiano Lucarelli and Giorgio Chiellini take part.

results.title: Eco
results.overview: Love leaves traces that resonate far beyond what we see.

results.title: The Anniversary
results.overview: Salim, a young Palestinian musician returns home to celebrate his parent’s wedding anniversary. Upon his arrival, he and his family’s true priorities are put into question when his mother requests that he drop out of college in order to help their struggling family business. Now with his future on the line, Salim must choose between his personal ambitions and his responsibilities to the family that raised him.

results.title: The Boatman
results.overview: Joaquim is released early from prison after sixteen years. Hiding it from his family, he takes on a dangerous job as a boatman ferrying illegal clam-pickers out into the river as a way to buy his daughter the piano he once promised her.

results.title: Their Town
results.overview: When Abby’s boyfriend unexpectedly drops out of the high school play, she is forced to help outlier Matt step into the role opposite her. Over the course of a long night wandering their small town, the two examine their futures and unearth surprises from their past.

results.title: You, Always
results.overview: Ethan is a devoted best friend who soon realises he has long been in love with Dr Jen Bell. However, Jen’s world is turned upside down by the arrival of a charismatic author named Patrick.

results.title: Atlas of the Universe
results.overview: After mistakenly buying two right-footed shoes, a ten-year-old boy sets off across the countryside to find the missing left one. An unexpected journey of courage, friendship and self-discovery.

results.title: Gueule cassée
results.overview: In the turquoise-tiled bathroom he shares with his sister, a teenager shuts himself away, soaking in the words of an unhinged masculinist influencer.

results.title: Welcome to the Countryside
results.overview: A family on the brink of crisis decides to escape the city and take refuge in an old farmhouse in the countryside, convinced that returning to nature is the only real solution. But the bucolic dream soon turns into an exhilarating struggle for survival. Escaping the city is easy. Running away from yourself, a little less.

results.title: Devils in the Bush
results.overview: In a summer’s sweltering heat, 20-something Fei begins to suspect her boyfriend is cheating. As doubt takes root for Fei, she searches for connection elsewhere.

results.title: This Bloody Country
results.overview: In 1869, a family leaves Salt Lake City on an arduous journey to establish a new outpost of their church. They cart all their belongings, leaving safety behind. The terrain is rough and unforgiving. When an encounter with dangerous men turns violent, their attempt to flee proves futile. Left with no other choice, they must prepare to defend themselves from an expected attack. Their pursuers hold the advantage because a party of mostly women and children are no match for outlaws in the wild country… unless they are.

results.title: The Reaper of the West
results.overview: A lost soul navigates the Colorado West.

results.title: Erie
results.overview: Siblings Stella and Oscar return to their Pennsylvania hometown to investigate their sister Iris' unexplained death following a mysterious rise in suicides within the county.

results.title: When Wine Meets Coffee
results.overview: When Claire, a sophisticated wine expert, travels to Costa Rica, her carefully ordered world collides with Alex, a passionate coffee producer deeply rooted in his family’s land. As wine and coffee, past and present, begin to intertwine, an unexpected connection challenges what they thought they knew about love, memory, and the paths that bring people together.

results.title: Belly Hop
results.overview: A young couple trying to shoot rabbits in the desert. And of course… stuff gets very, very weird.

results.title: Models vs. Werewolves
results.overview: Five young models go to an Airbnb in the woods for a full moon that comes once every five hundred years. What starts off as the perfect girl's trip quickly becomes a nightmare as a pack of ancient werewolves are awoken by the new moon...

results.title: Last Meal
results.overview: When anything's on the menu, a condemned inmate's request becomes the prison's worst nightmare.
